Statistics.Experimental Design and Analysis: Designing controlled experiments, randomized trials, and factorial studies to test hypotheses across fields such as medicine, agriculture, and engineering, with analysis of resulting data.
Statistics.Biostatistics and Epidemiology: Statistical methods applied to biological and health data, including clinical trials, observational studies, survival analysis, and causal inference from empirical datasets.
Statistics.Bayesian Statistics: Empirical applications of Bayesian modeling, including hierarchical models, prior elicitation, posterior predictive checks, and real-world data analysis in science and engineering.
Statistics.High Dimensional and Multivariate Statis: Analysis of large-scale and complex datasets, including genomics, neuroimaging, and social network data, with emphasis on empirical validation through simulations and real-world experiments.
Statistics.Time Series and Spatial Statistics: Empirical modeling of temporal and spatial data from climate studies, finance, geosciences, and sensor networks; includes forecasting, spatiotemporal modeling, and measurement-based validation.
Statistics.Machine Learning and Statistical Learnin: Empirical development and testing of algorithms for supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning, including cross-validation, benchmark datasets, and real-world evaluation.
Statistics.Causal Inference and Observational Studi: Empirical methods for estimating causal effects from observational data, including instrumental variables, propensity scores, and natural experiments.

Applied Mathematics.Computational Science and Simulations: Numerical experiments, simulations of physical, biological, and engineered systems, verification and validation of computational models using empirical data.
Applied Mathematics.Mathematical Modeling of Biological Syst: Empirical modeling of population dynamics, epidemiology, neuroscience, and cellular processes, validated with experimental or observational data.
Applied Mathematics.Optimization and Control: Empirical testing of optimization algorithms, control strategies, and operational research models on real-world or experimental datasets, including robotics, energy, and logistics.
Applied Mathematics.Numerical Analysis and Scientific Comput: Development and testing of numerical methods (ODEs, PDEs, linear algebra) validated through computational experiments and real-world applications.
Applied Mathematics.Stochastic Processes and Applications: Empirical studies of random processes in finance, physics, biology, and queuing systems, including Monte Carlo simulations and comparison with experimental or observational data.
Applied Mathematics.Dynamical Systems and Complex Systems: Experimental and computational studies of nonlinear, chaotic, and emergent behavior in engineering, physics, and biological systems, validated with real-world data.
Applied Mathematics.Network Science and Data Analysis: Empirical investigation of social, biological, and technological networks, including analysis of connectivity, dynamics, diffusion, and validation against observed network data.

Interdisciplinary Applications.Computational Biology and Bioinformatics: Empirical analysis of genomic, proteomic, and cellular data; development and benchmarking of computational models against experimental datasets.
Interdisciplinary Applications.Financial and Economic Statistics: Empirical modeling of market data, risk analysis, econometrics, and simulations to test predictive performance and strategy outcomes.
Interdisciplinary Applications.Environmental and Earth Data Analysis: Empirical analysis of climate, geophysical, and ecological datasets; modeling and simulation validated with field measurements and sensor networks.
Interdisciplinary Applications.Industrial and Engineering Applications: Applied statistical and computational studies in manufacturing, quality control, logistics, energy systems, and experimental testing of mathematical models in engineered settings.
